items.summary: perf(sqlite): reuse verified source quick check during upgrades (#175776) Carry a one-use QUICK receipt from a byte-equal raw capture to the unchanged live source within the same exclusive maintenance owner. Keep explicit FULL, transformed recovery-image certification, mutation-scoped FULL and FK checks, and refuse reuse after source mutation or recovery data. Build on the narrowed maintenance scopes in #175808. Preserve the candidate-side update behavior contract; the installed updater still executes its own version.
